messages.content: You check claims about a scientific paper against the evidence each one cites. A claim is supported only if the cited evidence says it AS WRITTEN: the same subject, row, column, setting and number. A correct value attached to the wrong subject or row is NOT supported, and neither is a claim that goes beyond its evidence. Judge only from the cited evidence; figure images are attached where a claim cites a figure. Give a verdict for every claim.

Claims:
1. "The embedding method that performed the best overall across all model architectures on the Visual7W dataset with IoU + QoU decoys was MLP-IQA, achieving 61.5% accuracy." -- cites: E3 (Section Table 12): quote "MLP-IQA 61.5 60.2 45.1"
2. "The performance of MLP-IQA was significantly better than the other methods, as it achieved the highest accuracy of 61.5% on the Visual7W dataset with IoU + QoU decoys." -- cites: E3 (Section Table 12): quote "MLP-IQA 61.5 60.2 45.1"
3. "The evidence does not provide a direct comparison of MLP-IQA's performance to other embedding methods across all model architectures on the Visual7W dataset with IoU + QoU decoys." -- cites: E3 (Section Table 12): quote "MLP-IQA 61.5 60.2 45.1"

Cited evidence:
[E3] (text, Section Table 12, page 17): Table 12: Test accuracy (%) on Visual7W, compar- ing different random decoy strategies to our methods: (A) Orig + uniformly random decoys from unique cor- rect answers, (B) Orig + weighted random decoys w.r.t. their frequencies, and All (Orig+IoU +QoU). Method (A) (B) All MLP-A 39.6 11.6 15.6 MLP-IA 53.4 40.3 22.2 MLP-QA 52.3 50.3 31.9 MLP-IQA 61.5 60.2 45.1 Random 10.0 10.0 10.0

verdicts.reason: The claim states that MLP-IQA achieved 61.5% accuracy, which matches the value in the cited evidence for the 'All' row under the 'All' column.
The claim states that MLP-IQA achieved the highest accuracy of 61.5%, which is supported by the evidence showing that MLP-IQA has the highest value in the 'All' column.

The evidence does not provide a direct comparison of MLP-IQA's performance to other embedding methods across all model architectures. The evidence only shows the performance of MLP-IQA and other methods under the 'All' strategy, not across all model architectures.
